verdict.rationale: Live probes confirm a working llms.txt at code.claude.com/llms.txt. They also confirm that docs pages are served as raw markdown (e.g. skills.md) with an embedded pointer telling agents where to fetch the full documentation index. The platform skills guide is likewise published as .md, and the skills themselves are spec-conformant SKILL.md files that third-party tooling installed and read cleanly. Missing for 10: no probe confirming an llms.txt for the platform.claude.com API docs or an llms-full.txt bundle, and no independent community report of agents being pointed at these docs.
